description: This file defines a class 'MultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain' which manages stream subscriptions, handles message consumption, resumption, and tracking of message counts within an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes methods for subscribing, resuming, stopping, and querying subscriptions, as well as internal logic for message handling and error processing.

classes.name: MultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages multiple stream subscriptions, tracks message counts, and handles activation/deactivation within Orleans.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A helper class for counting messages, with methods to increment and clear the count.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes to a stream and starts consuming messages, tracking the subscription handle.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a previous subscription handle and continues message consumption.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a stream and stops message consumption.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all active subscription handles for a given stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of current message counts per subscription handle.

methods.name: ClearNumberConsumed
methods.description: Clears message counts for all tracked subscriptions.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain by calling DeactivateOnIdle.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, logs, and increments counters.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles errors during message processing, logs, and increments error counters.
